title: Joseph of Arimathea brings the Grail to England and receives land from Arviragus

tellings.quote: when Joseph of Arythea arrived in England, he met up with Arvaros, the the pagan chieftain, who then granted him 120 hides of land as the sacred precinct where he would establish the first Christian church according to legend.

plain: Randall Carlson, a researcher of ancient history, retells an old legend on Jesse Michels's podcast. According to the legend, Joseph of Arimathea, a follower of Jesus in the Bible, came to England with the Holy Grail, the sacred cup of Christian lore, and met a pagan chieftain named Arviragus. Carlson says the chieftain gave him 120 hides of land, an old English measure, at Glastonbury as a sacred ground where he built the first Christian church.
